title: Nafasi katika maandishi. (Theme 4: Usafiri)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child counts the words aloud before writing, then writes each word whole with one finger space after it.
representations: a finger or lolly stick as a space measure
word cards to lay out with gaps
a sentence strip to cut into words
steps: Put a finger space after each word.
contexts: usafiri: a sentence about the bus

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes two sentences with a finger space after every word.

misconceptions.repair: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.

misconceptions.ask: Ga ri ni neno moja au mawili?
misconceptions.repair: Silabi za neno moja hukaa pamoja: gari.
Kila nafasi iwe sawa na kidole kimoja.

checks.question: Ni ipi sahihi: "ninakwenda" au "ni na kwenda"?
